description: analogWrite on the 15 PWM pins of the Mega 2560 (timers 0 to 5) and the switch from PWM back to digital.
basis: wiring_analog.c of arduino:avr@1.8.8 with digital_pin_to_timer_PGM of the mega variant (2:3B 3:3C 4:0B 5:3A 6:4A 7:4B 8:4C 9:2B 10:2A 11:1A 12:1B 13:0A 44:5C 45:5B 46:5A): analogWrite(0) and analogWrite(255) are digitalWrite(LOW/HIGH), other values set OCRnx; wiring.c runs timers 0 to 5 in 8-bit PWM modes, so the duty cycle equals the value; digitalWrite on a PWM pin clears its COM bits (turnOffPWM)
